description: This file implements the SceneSet plugin class for the WPEFramework, managing application lifecycle, initialization, and notifications related to a reference application within the plugin architecture.

classes.name: SceneSet
classes.description: A plugin class managing scene application lifecycle, initialization, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: SceneSet::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the app manager, and starts the reference app.

methods.name: SceneSet::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters notifications.

methods.name: SceneSet::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: SceneSet::OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change notifications.

methods.name: SceneSet::StartReferenceApp
methods.description: Launches the reference application via the app manager.

methods.name: SceneSet::MonitorReferenceAppCrash
methods.description: Placeholder for monitoring reference app crashes.

methods.name: SceneSet::RestartReferenceApp
methods.description: Restarts the reference app if it crashes.
